@@U02886@@
Formerly 浮士德’ study, unchanged. 梅菲斯特 steps from behind a curtain. Raising it, he looks back and 浮士德 is discovered prostrate on an old-fashioned bed.

@@U02888@@
Lie there, luckless wretch, misled into a love not easy to break. A man paralyzed by 海伦 will not so readily reclaim his senses.

@@U02889@@
(Looking about him.)

@@U02890@@
I look around, here, there, wherever my eye lights, and see that nothing is changed, nothing damaged. The painted panes are dimmer, or so it seems; cobwebs everywhere; ink dried, yellowed paper— but nothing out of place; even the pen still here, used by 浮士德 to sign himself over to the Devil.

@@U02891@@
(Picks up the pen.)

@@U02892@@
Ah, yes! Here it is! A droplet of blood still lodged in the tube of the quill, the very same blood I had to coax from him. What a collector’s piece! A unique specimen! And here’s the old fur robe hanging on its ancient peg,
translation:
@@U02886@@
原浮士德书房，不变。 梅菲斯特从窗帘后面走出来。他举起它，回头一看，发现浮士德躺在一张老式床上。

@@U02888@@
躺在那里，不幸的不幸者，被误导进入了一段不易破裂的爱情。一个被海伦麻痹的人是不会轻易恢复理智的。

@@U02889@@
（看着他。）

@@U02890@@
我环顾四周，这里，那里，无论我的眼睛在哪里，都发现没有任何改变，没有任何损坏。涂漆的玻璃颜色较暗，或者看起来是这样；到处都是蜘蛛网；墨水干了，纸泛黄了——但没有什么不合适的地方；就连浮士德用来向魔鬼签名的笔也还在这里。

@@U02891@@
（拿起笔。）

@@U02892@@
啊，是的！这里是！鹅毛管里还残留着一滴血，这正是我从他身上骗出来的血。多么值得收藏的作品啊！一个独特的标本！这是挂在古老的钉子上的旧毛皮长袍，
